backstory: Weeska feeds the dock hands from the fire at the market. She came to Black Rose as a cook on a prison barge, decades ago, and never got back on it. She salts everything, out of habit.
temperament: Warm with regulars, short with strangers until they eat.
manner: Bossy and motherly with those she knows; plain with others.
wants: Salt that is not damp.
grudge: Ahkeeh, who says her stew is too salty.
notices: Who has not eaten.
opinions: Thinks Lux Ha works too hard; thinks Nuxi-Ra overcharges.
secret: She can still cook for fifty, and she misses it.

trade: street vendor at the market
spot: at her stall beside the market's cooking fire
backstory: Nuxi-Ra sells odds and ends from a stall by the market's fire: whatever the boats bring in. She buys from every crew and asks none of them where it came from. She has never been robbed.
temperament: Calculating, brisk and polite in a cold way.
manner: Businesslike; speaks of everything as goods.
wants: A ship's whole cargo, once.
grudge: Ten-Coins, who takes a share of her stall every week.
notices: What a stranger might sell.
opinions: Thinks Weeska gives food away; thinks Rows-Against-It is the only captain who pays on time.
secret: Half her stock came off a boat no one admits to owning.

trade: boat captain at the market dock
spot: on the market dock beside her boat
backstory: Rows-Against-It runs her boat from the market dock to wherever a fare will take her. She paid off her owing on the water and kept the boat. She takes no orders from crossing-keepers now.
manner: Rough, salty; calls a fare a fare.
wants: A second boat and a crew she pays in coin.
grudge: The crossing-keepers, who once held her owing.
notices: Weather, current and a stranger's purse.
opinions: Thinks Nuxi-Ra drives a fair bargain; thinks Sakeeth thinks too much of herself.
secret: She still has her owing papers, and she reads them when she is angry.

trade: guard at the market
spot: at the market, by the cooking fire
backstory: Teeda-Wan keeps the peace at the market. He is the best fighter on the docks and the worst at explaining himself. He would rather settle things with a look.
manner: Laconic; a look and three words.
wants: A market day without a brawl.
grudge: Drunks.
notices: Hands near belts.
opinions: Thinks Okaw-Sei will learn; thinks Lux Ha should be paid more.
secret: He was a prisoner at the Rose once, and the market does not know.

trade: guard in the north district
spot: by a house in the north district, beside Shaleem
backstory: Iron-Jaw took a cudgel to the face in his first year and kept the name. He has been in the north district since. He reads well, and that surprises people.
manner: Slow speech, long pauses; reads things aloud.
wants: Books.
grudge: People who think he is stupid.
notices: Writing on anything.
opinions: Thinks Shaleem is the best guard in the town; thinks Zeeki is clever.
secret: He reads Shaleem's orders to his and never tells anyone.

trade: guard at the north landing
spot: at the north landing, near the boats
backstory: Raxa-Tum guards the north landing, where the fishing boats tie up. He was once a fisher himself. He still helps haul nets when no one is watching.
temperament: Friendly with fishers, wary with strangers.
manner: Plain and outdoorsy.
wants: To fish again.
grudge: Watches-The-Road, who reports him for hauling nets.
notices: Catches and weather.
opinions: Thinks Okeemu is the best fisher in town; thinks Watches-The-Road is a tattler.
secret: He keeps a line in the water off the landing during his watch.

trade: guard on the north road
spot: on the north road above the town's northern marker post
backstory: Watches-The-Road guards the north road into town. He reports every lapse he sees, including other guards'. It has not made his friends.
manner: Formal, cold; reports rather than talks.
wants: Promotion.
grudge: Raxa-Tum, who fishes on duty.
notices: Rules broken.
opinions: Thinks Raxa-Tum should be dismissed; thinks the north families are decent.
secret: He failed his first watch and was nearly dismissed himself.

trade: fisher at the north landing
spot: at the north landing with his family
backstory: Okeemu fishes from the north landing with his family. He is the best fisher in the town and does not boast of it. His boat is the oldest at the landing.
manner: Gentle, few words.
wants: Enough fish for the family.
grudge: None he will name.
notices: Fish, water and his child.
opinions: Thinks Raxa-Tum is a good friend; thinks Watches-The-Road is too hard.
secret: His boat leaks, and he has not told his wife.

trade: fishwife at the north landing
spot: at the north landing with her family
backstory: Heshra guts and sells Okeemu's catch at the north landing. She runs the family; she only fishes. Nobody bargains with her twice.
manner: Fast, haggling; dismissive of fools.
wants: A better price at the market.
grudge: Nuxi-Ra, who undercuts her.
notices: Prices.
opinions: Thinks Okeemu is too soft; thinks Nuxi-Ra cheats.
secret: She knows the boat leaks.

trade: child at the north landing
spot: at the north landing with her parents
backstory: Pip is Okeemu's and Heshra's daughter. She helps with the nets and wants to be a guard. She practises with a stick.
manner: Quiet; serious.
wants: To be a guard.
grudge: The boys who laugh at her stick.
notices: Guards.
opinions: Thinks Raxa-Tum is the best guard; thinks Watches-The-Road is scary.
secret: She knows her father's boat leaks.

trade: guard on the path above the south docks
spot: on the path above the south docks, near a rowing boat
backstory: Holds-Fast earned the name in a brawl on the docks, when he was the last one standing. He has guarded the south path ever since. He would rather be feared than liked.
temperament: Hard, blunt and hard to impress.
manner: Few words, all of them flat; ends a talk by turning away.
wants: A real fight, once more, to prove the name.
grudge: Ten-Coins, who takes money he will not touch.
notices: Weapons, and how a stranger holds them.
opinions: Thinks Sakeeth knows boats and nothing else; thinks Ten-Coins will hang one day.
secret: He keeps his brawl winnings in a jar under his bed and has never spent a coin.

trade: guard on the path above the south docks
spot: on the path above the south docks, near Holds-Fast
backstory: Mireel came to Black Rose as a runaway from a Lilmoth crew and stayed. The guard took his because he could read. He keeps the duty rolls for the south docks.
temperament: Precise, tidy and a little superior.
manner: Correct and clipped; quotes the rules by number.
wants: A clerk's post in the town, out of the rain.
grudge: Lilmoth, which he ran from and still dreams about.
notices: Spelling, papers and anyone lying about where they came from.
opinions: Thinks Holds-Fast is a brute but a useful one; thinks Lilmoth is a midden.
secret: His Lilmoth crew still lists his as owing, and he checks every new face for theirs.

trade: guard between the south docks and the market
spot: between the south docks and the market's cooking fire
backstory: Ten-Coins got his name for the price of looking away. Everyone at the docks knows it, and most have paid it. He thinks of it as a fee.
manner: Friendly-sounding but always bargaining; drops hints about prices.
wants: A bigger cut of the market's trade.
grudge: Holds-Fast, who glares at him every time he takes a coin.
notices: Purses, and who is carrying something they should not.
opinions: Thinks Holds-Fast is a fool for refusing coin; thinks Nuxi-Ra's stall makes the most money at the market.
secret: He owes more than he takes, to someone at the Rose.

trade: guard on the east dock
spot: on the east dock between a house and the boats
backstory: Corvane took a soldier's name from a deserter who taught him the sword. He came to Black Rose with that deserter and stayed after him. He guards the east dock and the big ship moored past it.
temperament: Reserved, dutiful and a little sad.
manner: Measured, soldierly; few questions.
wants: To learn where his teacher went.
grudge: The ship crews who mock the town guard.
notices: Swords and how they are worn.
opinions: Thinks Pitch-Pot works harder than anyone on the docks; thinks Tuh-Weem gossips.
secret: His teacher deserted twice; Corvane helped the second time.

trade: caulker who seals the boats at the east dock
spot: on the east dock, by the boats and the big ship
backstory: Pitch-Pot seals hulls with hot pitch and smells of it all year. He got the name as a hatchling, when he fell into the pot. He works on the big ship moored at the east docks whenever its crew will pay.
manner: Loud, laughs at his own jokes; talks about tar.
wants: A season's work on the big ship.
grudge: The big ship's mate, who never pays the full price.
notices: Leaks, cracks and rot.
opinions: Thinks Corvane is a good sort; thinks Mends-The-Hulls does careless work.
secret: He once sealed a hidden hold in the big ship and was paid double not to mention it.

trade: reed-weaver who works off her owing in mats
spot: on the road below the jail, by a house
backstory: Pays-In-Reeds weaves mats and baskets from marsh reed and pays her owing in them, one mat a day. She lives in a house by the road below the jail. She does not mind the work, only the ledger.
manner: Quiet, practical; counts in mats.
wants: The last mat.
grudge: Whoever keeps the ledger.
notices: Reed, weather and who looks hungry.
opinions: Thinks Ruh-Jaal is kind under her fear; thinks Skink should be in a home.
secret: She weaves one extra mat a week and sells it for herself.

trade: net-mender at the market dock
spot: beside the market's cooking fire, mending nets
backstory: Lux Ha mends every net that comes off the market boats, and she is never short of work. She was born in Black Rose and has never left it. She knows every family on the docks by their knots.
manner: Soft, unhurried; talks while her hands work.
wants: To see the sea once.
grudge: Crews who bring their nets back torn and pay late.
notices: Knots, rope and who has been in a fight.
opinions: Thinks Weeska is the kindest person at the market; thinks Teeda-Wan is lonelier than she looks.
secret: She has a little coin saved for a passage to the coast.

trade: fisher at the far east dock
spot: at the far east dock in front of her house
backstory: Ree-Shaal fishes from the far east dock and lives in the house behind it. She moved out to the edge to be away from the town. She likes the quiet, and visitors spoil it.
manner: Terse; answers what was asked and no more.
wants: To be left alone.
grudge: Sleeps-Standing, who snores on her dock.
notices: Fish, weather and footsteps.
opinions: Thinks the town is too loud; thinks Ojeel is decent for a ship hand.
secret: She keeps her catch's best fish for the child at the big ship.

trade: guard at the far east dock
spot: at the far east dock, by the houses
backstory: Sleeps-Standing guards the dock at the town's eastern edge, where nothing happens. He has learned to sleep on his feet. He wakes quickly when he must.
temperament: Lazy, good-humoured and shrewder than he looks.
manner: Drawling, yawns; sudden sharpness.
wants: To keep the quietest post in Black Rose.
grudge: Ree-Shaal, who complains about him.
notices: More than he lets on.
opinions: Thinks Ree-Shaal is sour; thinks the market guards work too hard.
secret: He saw who took a boat at night and said nothing.

trade: hand who unloads the big ship at the east docks
spot: by the house beside the big ship at the east docks
backstory: Ojeel unloads the big ship whenever it comes in and lives in the house by its berth. He signed on to a crew once and walked off it here. He has not decided whether that was clever.
manner: Plain and slow; thinks before answering.
wants: Steady work without a crew's owing.
grudge: The big ship's mate, who wanted him back.
notices: Cargo and its weight.
opinions: Thinks Pitch-Pot is good company; thinks Tadpole should be kept off the ships.
secret: He still owes the crew that he walked off.

trade: child who plays around the big ships
spot: by the second big ship at the east docks
backstory: Tadpole plays between the big ships on the east docks and runs errands for the crews. He belongs to everyone and no one. He knows every board on the dock.
manner: Fast, breathless questions; brags.
wants: To sail on a big ship.
grudge: Ojeel, who chases him off the ships.
notices: Coins on the ground and open hatches.
opinions: Thinks Ree-Shaal gives the best fish; thinks the guards are slow.
secret: He sleeps under the dock when it rains.

trade: fish smoker at the fire west of the gate
spot: by his cooking fire west of the west gate, under the tower
backstory: Ahkeeh smokes fish over the fire outside the west gate and sells it to the guards and to anyone coming in by road. He was born on a boat and came ashore when it sank. He has not been on the water since.
temperament: Easy-going and talkative once there is food in the conversation; cool before.
manner: Rambling, food-minded; measures time by how long a fish takes.
wants: A steady supply of fish now that he will not fetch it himself.
grudge: The boat crews at the docks, who charge him more every season.
notices: Smoke, weather and who looks hungry.
opinions: Thinks Tzeel-Vaa is the only honest guard at the gate; thinks Weeska's stew at the market is too salty.
secret: He is afraid of deep water and pays a child to fetch his fish from the dock.

trade: soldier of the levy who guards the hall
spot: indoors in the hall behind the iron door near the gate
backstory: Tuxeel-Zan is a soldier of Helstrom's levy posted inside the hall behind the gate's iron door. He prefers a roof to the street. He has heard every story told about Helstrom's guard and repeats the worst ones.
manner: Grunts, one-line answers; calls a stranger 'you' and nods at the door.
wants: A change of post that is not the street.
grudge: Gih-Xaleel, who keeps him indoors.
notices: Wet feet on the hall's floor.
opinions: Resents Gih-Xaleel but obeys him; thinks Azum-Kai will go far; thinks Stormhold folk are soft.
secret: He feeds a marsh rat that lives under the hall.
